products.name: DENTARA
products.summary: Editorial HTML template for dental website projects.
products.description: A self-contained HTML, CSS and JavaScript starting point for developers and small studios building a dental practice website. The commercial edition includes configurable branding, original geometric SVG artwork and English setup documentation.
features: Responsive layout with light and dark themes
Configurable branding and optional HTTPS booking link
Local SVG artwork and system fonts
English documentation and a self-contained source archive
requirements: Basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript knowledge
Static hosting or a local HTTP server
An external booking service if live appointments are needed
limitations: Codester review is pending. Purchase is not available yet.
Planned base price: $19; marketplace buyer fees may be added.
The default form is a local preview: it sends no requests and makes no appointments.
No CMS, backend, payment processing or hosting is included.
Chromium and Edge checks completed; Safari, Firefox and physical phones are not yet verified.
